vc_checking.summary: All seven target manual witnesses are semantically proofable. The implementation entail/return VCs are governed by one first-occurrence DLL split/rejoin family plus nil/nonempty suffix classification. The two public-contract derivations specialize dispatch_case to the unchanged abstract list and discharge the separating implication by pure equality conversion. The member derivation uses the representation fact that the sentinel is absent from the abstract node sequence. No C annotation or seed specification change is required; a small set of proved group-local helper declarations is likely useful.

natural_language_analysis.summary: Five implementation witnesses share the same complete-sequence cut and reclosure machinery. The two derived-contract witnesses instead use existential specialization and wand adjunction, so they form a second bounded group. Both groups are semantically closed under the current annotation and seed case_lib.

proof_groups.grouping_reason: Five witnesses share one first-occurrence decomposition and inverse segment-reclosure helper family, and are comfortably within max_witnesses_per_group=12.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: For entail_wit_1 split the anchor, open xizi_dll, and in the membership branch choose a first occurrence, split the segment, and prove the dispatch equation across the anchor-free prefix. For return_wit_1 classify a start=stop segment as nil and close the sentinel DLL. For return_wit_2 classify the member suffix as nil, join prefix/node/suffix, and close. For return_wit_3 unfold the nonempty suffix to identify node_next as its first value, apply the same join, and close. For return_wit_4 unfold the nonempty complete segment to identify first_value and close. Use only allowed structural tactics/lemmas; do not use forbidden equivalence/transitivity/sepcon-mono lemmas.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: Treat the heap as one circular DLL cut at either the sentinel or the queried member. The return expression reads the first address of the suffix: an empty suffix means NULL, while a nonempty suffix begins at the stored successor. Rejoining the same cut preserves ownership.
